title: Scholarship and Semester
author: Quentin Coldharbour
blurb: Ines Zhou, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
